references.title: DWDS: trotz
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Präposition (mit Genitiv); Etymologie under Trotz

notes.rationale: trotz aller guten Vorsätze, despite: the ADP Case Table lists its cases, but no Authored Inventory member is a Reading of it, so it is a segmenter case. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root trotz alone.
